## What changed

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Verification

- [ ] `ruby -c scripts/configure.rb`
- [ ] `ruby scripts/configure.rb --dry-run < /dev/null`
- [ ] `bundle exec jekyll build`
- [ ] Desktop layout checked
- [ ] Mobile layout checked
- [ ] Keyboard and reduced-motion behavior checked when relevant

## Template boundary

- [ ] The change contains no private data, credentials, personal photos, or restricted assets.
- [ ] The sample content remains reusable across disciplines.
- [ ] User-facing setup changes are documented in both READMEs.
